name: Over-flagging chain A <- B <- C <- D
about: One chain joined by extension edges (each dependent's edge points at the topic it depends on: B -> A, C -> B, D -> C). A's Deadline is updated. B (the launch date) and C (the press briefing, scheduled from the launch) need revision. D (the catering head count) is joined to C by an extension edge but does not depend on A's Deadline: the anti-trap. A flag on D is a flag not needed.
